lore_anchors.definition: The floating jade palace in the sky, a central dungeon of this arc.
Man Brutal Beard’s signature body-cultivation technique; its outer manifestation is a coat of golden, impervious scales.
The condensed spiritual form of a high-level cultivator, enabling independent survival after physical death.
Extreme Yin Patriarch’s main cultivation technique, claimed to be on par with the Heavenly Devil Arts at its peak.
A foundational mental cultivation technique from the Thousand Bamboo School; strengthens divine sense and protects the mind.
The self-proclaimed former master of Extreme Yin Island’s founder; exists as a ‘thousand-year-old ghost’ in a Profound Soul Body.
A rare spirit fruit that extends lifespan, harvested from a specific tree within the Void Heaven Palace.
A high-grade demon beast whose inner core is beneficial to the Heavenly Devil Arts.
A high-level demonic-path cultivator mentioned as a peer of Man Brutal Beard and the Twin Saints; likely a major faction leader.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Man Brutal Beard examine Han Li so carefully?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He senses Han Li's unusually strong spiritual sense and immediately recognizes him as a high-potential asset worth poaching or probing.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Han Li really Extreme Yin’s disciple now?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No—it is a tactical claim, not a real master-disciple bond, made to protect Han Li from being casually targeted or taken.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Man Brutal Beard get suspicious of the Azure-clad Elder’s interference?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, defending a low-level cultivator too eagerly signals a hidden secret—Man Brutal Beard recognizes this immediately.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the balance of power in this scene?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Extreme Yin and the Azure-clad Elder (demonic duo) + Man Brutal Beard (wildcard) vs. Wan Tianming and two allies (righteous trio); numbers are roughly even but the chemistry is tense.
